All.Name: Combined Ranking
All.Detial: Rankings are based on the combined performance of heroes in the Cursed Realm, Treasure Scramble and Campaign chapters.

WorldBoss.Name: Campaign
WorldBoss.Detial: Complete stages to get tons of rewards and unlock more functions and features.

CurseLand.Name: Cursed Realm
CurseLand.Detial: You can participate after reaching Resonating Crystal Lvl 350 or having 30 Ascended Tier Heroes. Battle the Final Boss of the Cursed Realm in multiple teams and earn tons of rewards according to your ranking.

IdlePVP.Name: Treasure Scramble
IdlePVP.Detial: You can participate after completing Chapter 24. Send teams to fight in the wild with other players, and receive tons of rewards based on your ranking.
